output: html_document

---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggprism)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells <- read_csv("../Data/pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells.csv")
```

```{r}
show_col_types = FALSE
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells <- pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells %>%
  mutate(ratio = (EduPositiveCells / TotalCells)*100)
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary <- pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells %>%
  group_by(Genotype, Group, Replicate) %>%
  summarise(ratio = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
stat_results <- pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary %>%
  group_by(Genotype) %>%
  rstatix::t_test(ratio ~ Group) %>% 
  rstatix::add_significance("p") %>%
  rstatix::add_xy_position(x = "Group", step.increase = 0.5, dodge = 0.8)
print(stat_results)
```
```{r}
ggplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1), limits = c(0, 100)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    data = pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary,
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio), 
    fill = "grey85",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    data = pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells,
    aes(x = Group, y = ratio, colour = as.factor(Replicate)),
    width = 0.2, height = 0, size = 3, alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_results,
    label = "p.signif",
    tip.length = 0.05,
    bracket.size = 0.7,
    hide.ns = TRUE
  ) +
  theme_prism() +
   xlab(NULL) +
  ylab("% of Edu+ Follicle Cells") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
```{r}
ggsave("../Results/pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells.pdf", width= 6, height= 5)
```

```{r}
pnutrnai_ratio <- pnutrnai_edupositivecells_totalcells_summary

t.test(ratio ~ Group, data = pnutrnai_ratio)
```
